fal.note: Official fal hosted MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration). On first use the user signs in to fal in the browser; no API key is pasted. Main tools: recommend_model, search_models, browse_models, get_model_schema, get_pricing, estimate_cost, upload_file, run_model, submit_job, submit_jobs, check_job, wait_for_jobs, get_job_result, cancel_job, show_media, search_docs, plus fal Library tools for saved assets, collections and smart entities.
